tweets: Gomateśvara, Śravaṇabeḻagoḻa — every twelve years, scaffolding rises around the seventeen-metre granite colossus for Mahāmastakābhiṣeka: thousands of kalaśas of milk, turmeric, sandal paste and gold dust poured over Bāhubali's head, a rite performed for centuries.
